test_cases.name: writes_intent_without_design
test_cases.input: Viết intent.md cho ý tưởng: khách hàng muốn xem lịch sử đơn hàng theo tháng
assertions: Asks analyst questions one at a time (what cannot be done today, who is affected, what better looks like, what is out of scope) before writing the file
Creates docs/physarum/intents/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>-intent.md with Status: draft
File contains the sections Problem, Proposed outcome, Affected users and systems, Constraints, Out of scope, Open questions, Classification
Does NOT put endpoints, file paths, estimates, or implementation options in any field
Stops after writing and does NOT invoke brainstorming or writing-plans

test_cases.name: spec_request_still_writes_intent_first
test_cases.input: Viết luôn spec cho tính năng export CSV giúp tôi, khỏi intent
assertions: Writes intent.md first and states in one line that design/spec is a separate gate
Does NOT write spec.md in the same turn
Does NOT invoke brainstorming before the intent is accepted

test_cases.name: unconfirmed_assumptions_go_to_open_questions
test_cases.input: Ticket: 'Báo cáo doanh thu chậm'. Có thể do query, chắc là cần cache. Ghi intent.
assertions: Sets Source: ticket and keeps a Source ref pointing to the ticket
Puts 'needs cache' under Open questions, NOT under Constraints
Keeps the originator's words in Problem and Proposed outcome
Does NOT write 'add cache' or any approach in Proposed outcome

test_cases.name: classifies_with_predicates_highest_first
test_cases.input: Intent: đổi schema bảng orders để tách địa chỉ giao hàng, đụng 3 module
assertions: Fills ## Classification with Class, Lane, and Signals
Evaluates T3 before T2, T1, T0 and picks T3 (schema change spanning modules)
Lane lists /spec → /adr → /plan → /implement → /verify → /ship
Signals state impact ('touches the orders schema'), NOT approach ('add a column')
States the proposed Class and Lane in one line for the originator to confirm or change

test_cases.name: alert_hotfix_needs_no_intent
test_cases.input: Alert: production checkout trả 500 từ 10 phút trước, khôi phục hành vi cũ
assertions: Classifies as T2 Hotfix/Debug
Says no intent is needed and names /debug → /verify → /ship
Does NOT create an intent.md file
Stops after naming the lane

test_cases.name: alert_needing_new_behavior_gets_new_intent
test_cases.input: Alert: nhiều user bị lock tài khoản. Cần thêm cơ chế unlock qua email, đổi auth flow.
assertions: Does NOT classify as T2 because new behavior and an auth change are required
Writes a NEW intent file instead of editing an old spec in place
Classifies as T3 because the auth model changes

test_cases.name: tiny_change_intent_optional
test_cases.input: Đổi tên biến userCnt thành userCount trong 1 file, có cần intent không?
assertions: Classifies as T0 Tiny/Quick
States intent is optional and short, and does NOT force one
Names lane /implement → /verify → /ship with no spec and no plan

test_cases.name: unknown_predicate_marks_provisional
test_cases.input: Intent: thêm trường ghi chú vào form đặt hàng. Tôi chưa biết có đụng API contract không.
assertions: Asks the missing predicate once, one question at a time
When the answer stays unknown, lists it in Open questions
Marks Class as provisional

test_cases.name: accept_sets_status_and_stops
test_cases.input: PO đã accept intent này, tôi là Lan, hôm nay 2026-11-13.
assertions: Sets Status: accepted and Accepted by with name and date
Does NOT start design or invoke brainstorming
Points to the first command of the intent's Lane
